# Sunshine Coin Laundry

> Self-service coin laundromat at 10808 S Vermont Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90044 (South LA). It sits on the east side of Vermont Ave between 108th St and 109th St, in the Vermont Vista area of the City of Los Angeles, directly across the street from Westmont. Open every day 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM; last wash starts at 8:30 PM. Operated by CC Laundry System LLC.

Website: https://cclaundrysystem.com/
Phone and text: (213) 684-8487
Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=1095974457556731612

## Facts

- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Last wash 8:30 PM.
- Attendant on site: 9:00 to 11:00 AM, 3:00 to 4:30 PM, and 7:00 to 10:00 PM.
- Machines: self-service washers including 80 lb large-capacity washers, and 75 lb dryer tumblers. Good for king-size comforters, duvets, sleeping bags and bulk loads.
- Payment: coin-operated. Bill-to-coin changers on site, so customers only need cash.
- Free on-site parking, RV access, vending machines for snacks, drinks and soap, folding tables.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Neighborhoods served: Westmont, Vermont Vista, West Athens, Vermont Knolls and the rest of South Los Angeles (ZIP 90044 and 90047).
- History: a neighborhood laundromat on this corner since the 1990s; CC Laundry System LLC took over and renovated it with new machines.
- Getting there: Metro bus lines 204 and 754 run on Vermont Ave and stop near the door. The 110 and 105 freeways are close by.
- Machine problem: text (213) 684-8487 with your name, machine number, time, the problem and a photo. The team replies and checks whether a refund is due. Overfilled machines are not refunded.
